claims.statement: An anonymous accusation naming Leonardo and others was lodged with the Ufficiali di Notte. The case was dismissed on 7 June 1476. The record also places him in Verrocchio's household.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Ufficiali di Notte.
